verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a dedicated official MCP server page that exposes classify, parse, extract, split and edit as tools to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf or any MCP client, with no custom integration code. It offers both a local MCP for local files and a hosted MCP for public URLs, and a probe confirmed the page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works in practice.
